verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents headless, scriptable operation. It boots from a container with env-var bootstrap credentials, ships the kcadm.sh Admin CLI and an Admin REST API for scripted administration, supports JSON realm import/export (including operator-automated realm import), and exposes health endpoints for readiness checks. Community users report real automation friction: inconsistent admin API payloads make idempotency hard, and config stored in the database resists infrastructure-as-code. missing for 10: first-party CI/pipeline guidance, idempotent declarative config without third-party tools, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
